title: Completing and Checking Out a Visit from Charting. – Curve Dental
markdown:
[Skip to main content](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/50475515134483-Completing-and-Checking-Out-a-Visit-from-Charting#main-content)

* * *

**Description**

This quick guide demonstrates how to complete and check out a visit from the Charting module.

**Important Note**

It is recommended as best practice to check out appointments from the schedule.

**Contents**

The following topics are covered in this guide:

- [Section 1](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/50475515134483-Completing-and-Checking-Out-a-Visit-from-Charting#1) \- Verify Visit Details
- [Section 2](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/50475515134483-Completing-and-Checking-Out-a-Visit-from-Charting#2) \- Complete the Visit
- [Section 3](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/50475515134483-Completing-and-Checking-Out-a-Visit-from-Charting#3) \- Checkout the Visit

**Steps**

Section 1 - Verify Visit Details

1\. In the Charting module, the check out is initiated on the Treatment Plan Card.

![Charting Treatment Plan Card](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/51546429779987)

2\. Identify the correct visit. The visit should indicate it is scheduled for the current date.

![Scheduled visit identification](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/51546420013587)

3\. Ensure all procedures performed today are listed in the visit. Any procedures not performed should be removed or deleted. Procedures can be added using the Charting menu or directly to the Treatment Plan Card.

![Add or remove procedures](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/51546429784851)

4\. Remove procedures from the visit that were not completed during the appointment, but do not delete a procedure if it still needs to be scheduled for the future. Use the link at the bottom of this article for detailed instructions on removing procedures.

![Remove procedure icon](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/51546420016019)

5\. If needed, click the **Provider field** to change the provider per procedure. When the visit is checked out, these details will be billed on the invoice, so accuracy is essential.

![Verify provider details](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/51546429794451)

Section 2 - Complete Visit

1\. Right-click the **Visit** to bring up the Visit menu, then click **Complete Visit**.

![Complete Visit menu option](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/51546429795731)

2\. This removes the visit from the Treatment Plan Card. It can now be found in the Completed window.

![Completed window location](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/51546429796499)

3\. The procedures in the visit change colors on the odontogram to indicate completion. If using default colors, they will turn blue.

![Completed procedure color change](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/51546420022163)

4\. Hover over the Completed window to expand the details. Note that completing the visit does not finalize the checkout.

![Expand completed visit details](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/51546420022419)

5\. On the Scheduler, the appointment color remains unchanged because the checkout has not yet been finalized.

![Scheduler appointment status](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/51546429799443)

6\. In the Charting module, right-click the completed **Visit** to bring up the context menu.

![Completed visit context menu](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/51546429800851)

7\. The menu includes the option to **Return to Plan**. Once a visit is completed, it cannot be edited; it must be returned to the plan to make modifications.

![Return to Plan option](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/51546420034451)

Section 3 - Check out Visit

1\. To finalize the process, click **Checkout Visit**.

![Finalize checkout button](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/51546420035603)

2\. The module switches to Billing. Click **Add** to finalize the checkout and post the items to the ledger.

![Finalize billing click add](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/51546420037011)

3\. The checkout is complete, and the procedures are added to an invoice.

![Invoice created display](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/51546429806227)

4\. In the Scheduler, the appointment changes color to indicate the checkout is finalized.

![Updated scheduler color](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/51546420039955)

5\. In Charting, the visit is now moved to History. Click **History** to view the record.

![Switch to History mode](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/51546429809299)

6\. In the History window, the visit displays with the date of service, procedures, site/material details, provider, and clinical notes.

![History record details](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/51546429810579)
